name: Banh nep
summary: Bánh nếp is a sticky-rice cake served at the Mang Den cultural night with cơm lam, grilled chicken, pork skewers, and rượu cần.
origin: Mang Den, at the cultural night after the 6 January race opening.
howToEat: Eat it with the rest of the cultural-night meal: cơm lam, gà nướng, thịt xiên, and rượu cần.
where: The cultural night at Không gian văn hóa “Thiên đường Tây Nguyên- Măng Đen”, held after a race opening on the afternoon of 6 January.
seoDescription: Bánh nếp, a sticky-rice cake on the Mang Den cultural-night table with cơm lam, grilled chicken, skewers, and rượu cần.
